node.acceptance_condition: Returns a three-part write-up labeled (a) strongest plain form, (b) honest concession, (c) surviving rebuttal, in essay-register prose, each part at least a few sentences and grounded in the 'kitsch-as-gatekeeping' direction.
node.expected_contribution: A finished, reusable steelman block on the gatekeeping objection with its concession and rebuttal, ready for synthesis.
node.objective: Develop the counterargument that accusing AI art of kitsch is historically a gatekeeping move made against new media and popular taste. Produce (a) the strongest plain-language form of the argument, (b) the concession a nuanced essay must honestly grant, and (c) the rebuttal that remains available to the thesis.
node.rationale: This is one of the two or three strongest independent objections and is analytically self-contained: it works entirely from cultural history and the sociology of taste, needing nothing a sibling produces.
